Ventilation openings through foundation walls or exterior walls in which the minimum net area of ventilation openings shall not be less than 1 square foot for each 150 square feet of under floor area. One such opening shall be within 3 feet of each corner of the building. 2. Mechanically ventilated crawl spaces with no openings through foundation or exterior walls. Floors above crawl spaces ventilated to the outdoors must have a minimum R-19 insulation.
